insights.summary: Finance and procurement push back on paying separately for add-ons (PreSense, QM seats, AI Voice Agent minutes) at renewal.
insights.quote: Signal AI being an add-on on top of call tracking is the one that gets him the most.

insights.summary: PreSense screen pop failing on transfer
insights.quote: The PreSense pops are fine when they show up, but we've had a couple of instances where a call transfers and the screen pop either doesn't fire on the second leg or it fires to the wrong agent.
